div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reconcile
desired vs actual
desired key, no DESIRED
call → dispatch at turn close
held by a DESIRED call → keep
key gone → SUPERSEDED
+ advisory cancel
if outcome unknown

EVALUATION HARNESS · input stream · external · virtual clock · any event can arrive at any time
text chunks + end-of-turn · audio clips · image frames · interrupt signal · tool manifest · tool results, possibly late

div.style: color: rgb(31, 17, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
PROTOCOL ADAPTER · ingress · the only code that knows the wire format
wire → internal events · manifest → tool specs · media → file references

div.style: color: rgb(31, 17, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
PROTOCOL ADAPTER · egress · encode actions · schema-validate every payload
speech · clarification · tool call with call_id · advisory cancel · final response + state snapshot

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
EVALUATION HARNESS · executes tools and scores the trace

JOURNAL

div.style: color: rgb(55, 65, 81) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
How to read
solid arrow = synchronous, inside one kernel step
dashed arrow = asynchronous message
SUPERSEDED = logically cancelled: its result is never used
